## Themes

### Quantitative pharmacology
Population PK, PK/PD modelling and simulation, exposure–response analysis, pharmacometric simulation and translational modelling.

### Clinical pharmacology
Clinical PK, exposure and bioavailability, dose selection and study-design support, exposure–response relationships and early-phase development.

### Preclinical / DMPK
DMPK, toxicokinetics, preclinical PK, PK/TK interpretation, cold PK, metabolite identification and radiolabelled (¹⁴C) study support.

### Computational science
R for pharmacometric workflows, Python for scientific data analysis, reproducible research, scientific visualization, workflow automation and generative AI for scientific productivity.

## Long-term direction

> **Pharmacokinetics + Pharmacodynamics + Modelling + Simulation + Data Science + AI**, applied to model-informed drug development, translational and clinical pharmacology, and AI-assisted quantitative pharmacology.
